impact: A hot CPI would cement a December hike and pressure high-multiple holdings (NBIS, PLTR, BE); a soft print extends Monday's relief rally.
summary: S&P 500 futures were up 0.07% and Nasdaq-100 futures up 0.19% Monday night ahead of October CPI (consensus +0.3% headline, +0.2% core). CME FedWatch puts about 80% odds on a December hike; WTI settled down more than 4%.
title: US futures flat ahead of CPI, December hike odds near 80%
